gen-gf-revalia-gf-marcellus-sc: Loose, swaggering and tall, Revalia strides across the line with an open-bottomed g and plenty of space between letters. Marcellus SC, a classic serif, is the quieter, literary one, with gentle modulation.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-montagu-slab: Big, brash and widely spaced, Revalia has an open g and short stalks over a tall band of letters. And Montagu Slab, a classic serif, answers with sturdy downstrokes, slender turns and a generous x-height.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Refined is not the first word Revalia suggests, yet its loose, wide-set letters give the page a bold, expressive start. Noto Serif Hentaigana follows with small letters nearly as tall as capitals and a calligraphic nib's subtle modulation.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-ovo: Authoritative Ovo, a text serif, takes over the reading with thins only slightly lighter than thicks and shallow ascenders. And above it Revalia stays loud, wide-set and bold, so a longer passage feels settled.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-karma: Trustworthy Karma, a text serif, has terminals that finish clear of the stem and a modulation that never snags the eye. And Shantell Sans above it keeps one fixed nib width, so a long passage feels steady.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-sentient: Sophisticated Sentient, a serif with pinched, closed-in apertures and slightly thinner crossbars, sits beneath a heading that looks bent from wire. And Shantell Sans, wide-mouthed and open, makes the two feel like opposite temperaments.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-karma: Round, blunt and confident, Sniglet keeps every curve as thick as its stems. And Karma, a text serif, settles into a soft, restrained thick-thin rhythm that would carry a long passage gently.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-literata: Sniglet holds a flat, constant line weight, with terminals that stop short of curling back in. Literata, a text serif, lightens its curves mildly toward the ends, so a longer passage feels bookish and unhurried.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-sentient: Sentient, a classic serif with pinched, closed-in apertures, takes the body, with crossbars a touch thinner than stems. But Sniglet is the open, commanding one up top, with level, weight-free letters, while Sentient does the finer work below.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-bespoke-slab: Grounded Bespoke Slab is a text serif, and its tall lowercase letters suit Snowburst One's stencil bridges and lanky build. Bespoke Slab's strongest quality is that shared height, which ties a bold heading to a refined body.
